option_relations.rationale: Age-related cardiac conduction disease is a broader term that can encompass various types of conduction abnormalities, including AV block.
Complete heart block (Third-degree AV block) is a specific type of AV block, which is a conduction disorder of the heart.
Third-degree atrioventricular block is another term for complete heart block, which is a type of AV block.
Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block) is a specific type of conduction disorder that can lead to AV block.
